scripts.dev: npm run env:sync && concurrently --success=last -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @zarva/backend" "npm run dev -w @zarva/frontend"
scripts.db:generate: npm run env:sync && npm run db:generate -w @zarva/backend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run env:sync && npm run db:migrate -w @zarva/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run env:sync && npm run db:seed -w @zarva/backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run env:sync && npm run dev -w @zarva/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run env:sync && npm run dev -w @zarva/frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @zarva/shared && npm run db:generate -w @zarva/backend
